name: Harrow, Inc.
summary: Harrow, Inc., an eyecare pharmaceutical company, engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of ophthalmic pharmaceutical products in the United States. It operates through Branded and ImprimisRx segments. The company offers ImprimisRx, an ophthalmology-focused compounded medications.
